bundle.shortDescription: Agent-agnostic smart routing proxy for LLM APIs
bundle.longDescription: Token Station is a local gateway that routes each Agent's requests to the right model by task complexity or by draining quota-bearing accounts before they reset. Runs an embedded router with sandboxed WASM adapters; credentials stay on this device.
